text: The follow-up registers domWindowOpenedAndLoaded with a messageWindow.xhtml predicate before opening the dialog. It then awaits the returned window, MsgLoaded and message-display completion, with activation and a tick afterward. Its caller adds parent-window focus; accepted later code targets msgc instead and uses later fallback handling. These are distinct source wait boundaries, not a reproduced intermittent cure.
title: The standalone message helper separates document selection from message readiness
